name: documentos_pagina_25
sql: explain(analyze,buffers,format json)with actor as materialized(select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',(select m.user_id::text from public.memberships m join public.user_roles r on r.organization_id=m.organization_id and r.user_id=m.user_id where m.organization_id='<UUID>' and r.role in('admin','engenharia')order by m.user_id limit 1),true) as claim) select octet_length(public.nr_consultar('<UUID>','NR33','documentos',jsonb_build_object('unidade_id',(select unidade_id from public.nr_documentos where organization_id='<UUID>'group by unidade_id order by count(*)desc limit 1),'pagina',0,'limite',25))::text)as payload_bytes from actor;

name: maior_derivado_detalhe
sql: explain(analyze,buffers,format json)with actor as materialized(select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',(select m.user_id::text from public.memberships m join public.user_roles r on r.organization_id=m.organization_id and r.user_id=m.user_id where m.organization_id='<UUID>' and r.role in('admin','engenharia')order by m.user_id limit 1),true) as claim) select octet_length(public.nr_consultar('<UUID>','NR33','documentos',jsonb_build_object('id',(select d.id from public.nr_documentos d join public.nr_documento_revisoes v on v.organization_id=d.organization_id and v.documento_id=d.id and v.id=d.revisao_atual_id where d.organization_id='<UUID>'and 'NR33'=any(d.normas)and d.dados->>'tipo'='derivado_docx_editavel'order by jsonb_array_length(v.conteudo->'blocos')desc,d.id limit 1)))::text)as payload_bytes from actor;
